name: DARE
one_liner: Anxiety and panic app based on Barry McDonagh's DARE book, with guided audio for panic attacks, worry, intrusive thoughts and sleep.
best_for: People with panic attacks who want an audio guide to use in the moment
People who liked the DARE book and want its approach in an app
People anxious about specific situations such as driving or flying
not_for: Anyone in crisis: call or text 988
People with severe anxiety, OCD or PTSD who need treatment from a clinician
People who don't want their data used for ads: the policy mentions ad personalization
short_description: DARE offers guided audio for panic, worry and anxious situations based on Barry McDonagh's book, with a paid premium tier.
long_description: DARE is an app from BMD Publishing based on Barry McDonagh's self-help book on anxiety and panic, which encourages you to accept and lean into anxious feelings rather than fight them. You get guided audio for panic attacks, worry, intrusive thoughts and sleep, plus tracks for situations such as driving or flying and a mood journal. Some content is free; a premium subscription with a free trial unlocks the full library and extras. The approach overlaps with acceptance- and exposure-based therapy, but we found no published study of the app. Its privacy policy is contradictory: it says it doesn't allow third-party behavioral tracking, but also that it uses data to personalize ads on other platforms.
patient_summary: DARE gives you guided audio to talk you through panic attacks and anxious moments, based on Barry McDonagh's book. Some audio is free; a premium subscription unlocks the rest after a free trial. It's a self-help tool, not treatment, so see a clinician if anxiety is taking over your life.

faqs.a: Free; membership about $12.99/month or $59.99–$69.99/year. Prices were checked in October 2026 and can change, so confirm with DARE before you sign up.

faqs.q: Can DARE replace therapy or treatment?
faqs.a: No. DARE is a self-help tool that can support your wellbeing or work alongside therapy, but it doesn't diagnose or treat conditions. If you're in crisis, call or text 988 in the US.
DARE is available on iPhone and Android.
Guided audio for panic and worry; Situation-specific tracks; Mood journal; Premium groups and live sessions.
